name: Pika
description: Pika is an AI video and image generation service with a free plan and Starter, Creator and Fancy paid plans.
features: Parallel video, image and audio generations
limitations: Free plan has 0 monthly credits (credit packs only) and no commercial licence
Plan credits do not roll over and payments are non-refundable

plans.name: Starter
highlights: 2 parallel video, 8 parallel image and audio

plans.name: Creator
highlights: 8 parallel video, 32 parallel image and audio
plans.note: The plan card also shows '$30' beside $35

plans.name: Fancy
plans.note: Ranges up to $880 monthly / $704 annual for larger credit tiers

free.details: 0 credits per month (credit packs only), 2 parallel video generations, no watermark, no commercial licence.

api.summary: A developer site is linked, but no prices were shown on the page we read.

notes: Credit packs: from $25 (1,500 credits) to $1,000 (66,000 credits). Top-up credits expire after 365 days. Payments are non-refundable per the FAQ.

verification.notes: Product active. Monthly view, USD: Free (no monthly credits, credit packs only), Starter $10/month with 900 credits, Creator $35/month with 3,150 credits; a Yearly toggle (save 20%) exists. Fancy and Enterprise were not re-read.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: A creative platform for video, image and audio with many models in one place

capabilities.title: Make video from a clip to a multi-shot piece
capabilities.text: Video Studio generates anything from a short clip to a 30-second multi-shot video.

capabilities.title: Lengthen a clip
capabilities.text: Extend Video makes a clip longer by generating extra frames.

capabilities.title: Create and edit images
capabilities.text: Image Studio gives creative control, and Edit Image swaps, removes or restyles elements.

capabilities.title: Score and voice a clip
capabilities.text: Pika Soundtrack adds music, ambience and foley matched to the action.

featureCards.name: Character Studio
featureCards.text: Creates a character you can reuse across creations.

featureCards.name: Color Grade
featureCards.text: Adjusts colour, contrast and mood in photos or clips.

featureCards.name: Product Shot
featureCards.text: Styled product images without a photoshoot.

featureCards.name: Music, Speech and SFX studios
featureCards.text: Three audio apps for music, voiceover and sound effects.

featureCards.name: Several models
featureCards.text: The site lists Pika's own models and models from other providers for video, image and audio.

featureCards.name: Developer membership
featureCards.text: Access to multiple models through one API.

audienceDetail.text: Both are named on the site.
Video Studio, Extend Video and Color Grade serve them.
A developer membership offers one API for several models.

scenarios.title: Craft one specific image
scenarios.text: Use Image Studio for fine control.

scenarios.title: Give footage a look
scenarios.text: Apply a grade with Color Grade.

scenarios.title: Add a voiceover for social media
Score a clip
scenarios.text: Use Pika Soundtrack to match sound to the picture.

gettingStarted.text: Use the sign-up button, or log in if you have an account.
The site links to templates made by other users.
The page does not describe the steps after sign-up, so the Help Center is the place to look.
